research.locationNote: Khalifa City, Abu Dhabi; distinct from Zayed City and the Dubailand village.
overview: Reportage identifies 312 townhouses. Its brochure and current page describe three bedrooms; the factsheet instead says four. Confirm the contracted revision.
research.priceNote: Property Finder records an AED 4,583,927 launch guide. A current developer unit quotation was not verified.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 10/51/39; Bayut mentions 30% upfront without a complete schedule. No original dated payment calendar was verified.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts September 2028; Bayut says Q1 2028. Reportage’s 65.81% progress display has no snapshot date. Obtain the contractual completion date.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Printed whole-home total includes outdoor space across ground, three upper levels and roof.

facts.label: Plan arrangement
facts.value: Three bedrooms, study and maid room; study and maid room are not counted as extra bedrooms.

facts.label: Private features
facts.value: Original documents show a roof pool; an internal lift is optional. Confirm the unit specification.
